en: Girl
Oh! Are we going to help train this Trainer, sir?
Boy
Really? But they look really tough!
Alder
Exactly! This Trainer may be tough, but there's as much to learn from losing as from winning.
And haven't I always told you? What matters most is that you and your Pokémon enjoy yourselves!
So, {player}! Please be their opponent.
Boy
OK! I'll show you what's cool about my Pokémon!
Alder
A fine battle, both of you! Now, before the next one, let's see to your Pokémon, {player}.
Girl
Some battles are decided by type matchups. Let me show you!
Alder
Now that was a rousing battle! I could tell every one of the Pokémon was enjoying itself.
Well, {player}? Types matter a great deal in battle. Water beats Fire, Fire beats Grass, Grass beats Water.
But listen! When a Pokémon uses a move of its own type, the move hits even harder. Remember that!
Let's heal these hard-working Pokémon. {starter}! You did a great job for {player}!
One more thing before you go. Take these!
Give a Pokémon an Oran Berry to hold, and it'll eat it by itself when its HP runs low in battle.
Now, the Gym Leader in Aspertia is a very strong Trainer. But don't worry. You'll do just fine!
After that, take on stronger Trainers, and the Gym Leader of every city. Grow together with your Pokémon!
Meeting Pokémon and people you'd never have met otherwise. That's the best thing about travelling!
Alder
Go and show Aspertia's Gym Leader what you and your Pokémon can do!
Oho! You won a Gym Badge! That comes of understanding your Pokémon and drawing out their strength.
Girl
My dream is to train my Pokémon here, and become the strongest Trainer in Unova!
Boy
I want to go to lots of places and learn all about Pokémon. Then I'll get even stronger!
